journal_lines: The water darkened beneath. Something vast passed. It did not stop.
Shadow below the hull. Too large. Kept moving. It did too.
Something old in the deep water. Stayed near the surface. It stayed deep. Agreement reached.
The laser feeling passed. Looked into the deep water. Nothing visible. Moved on.
Deep water monument in the distance. Did not swim toward it. Things swam toward me.
One moment normal ocean floor, next moment, watched. Surfaced and moved on.
The silence in the deep water was different from other silences.
A chill that had nothing to do with temperature. Surfaced.
Stayed shallow the rest of the way out. Worth the extra distance.
Something enormous and slow watching from the dark water. Both of us waited. I left first.
The monument temple in the distance. The guardian between us. Came home.
Whatever guards the monument decided the surface was enough. Correct.
